Lois Lowry on 'Building 903,' 'The Giver' and relationships between the old and young
building 903

NPR Music
Interview: Troye Sivan is leaning into loneliness
NEW TROYE tile.jpg

Troye Sivan's 2023 album, 'Something to Give Each Other,' marked a turning point in the Australian singer-songwriter's career. Its choreo-driven singles "Rush" and "Got Me Started" became viral hits, earned Sivan his first Grammy nominations. His new album, 'She's the Best,' gives the artist breathing room to dig into some darker feelings.
